mapper.select: SELECT doc_id, doc_type, title, status, initiator_id, draft_date, json_content, updated_at FROM DOCUMENTS WHERE doc_id= #{docId}

SELECT D.DOC_ID, D.DOC_TYPE, D.TITLE, D.STATUS, D.INITIATOR_ID, D.DRAFT_DATE, D.JSON_CONTENT, D.UPDATED_AT, U_INITIATOR.NAME AS INITIATOR_NAME, U_INITIATOR.DEPARTMENT AS INITIATOR_DEPARTMENT FROM DOCUMENTS D JOIN APPROVAL_HISTORY AH ON D.DOC_ID = AH.DOC_ID JOIN USERS U_INITIATOR ON D.INITIATOR_ID = U_INITIATOR.ID WHERE AH.APPROVER_ID = #{approverId} AND AH.ACTION = 'PENDING' ORDER BY D.DRAFT_DATE DESC

SELECT D.DOC_ID, D.DOC_TYPE, D.TITLE, D.STATUS, D.INITIATOR_ID, D.DRAFT_DATE, D.JSON_CONTENT, D.UPDATED_AT FROM DOCUMENTS D WHERE D.INITIATOR_ID = #{initiatorId} AND D.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY D.DRAFT_DATE DESC
